name: Inertial Skew Carousel
description: Full-screen horizontal image carousel driven by wheel and drag with inertia. Slides squash and images stretch with scroll speed, and a progress bar tracks position.
contents: Row of captioned image slides in grayscale frames
Progress bar in the bottom left corner
behavior: Mouse wheel and drag or touch move the track with eased inertia
Slides shrink and images stretch horizontally in proportion to speed
Images turn to color on hover
Progress bar scales with scroll position
editableByProps: Colors of background, captions, frames and progress bar
Inertia, drag speed, slide size and spacing

needsCodeEdit.change: Change how strongly speed distorts slides and images
needsCodeEdit.where: renderLoop function, the scale transforms inside carouselData.forEach
grayscale class on the img element

fixed: Listens to the window wheel event and moves the carousel with it, without blocking page scroll
Loads the Space Grotesk font through an @import in a style tag
Progress bar is fixed to the bottom left of the viewport
